nom: Drunk Elephant Amino Rain Glasswater Serum

avis.texte: Wow, I'm glad I tried this. Keeps skin plump and healthy and dewy!!❤️
Honestly this seems like just a really good makeup primer. I cant tell much on what its doing for me on a skincare level. Adds a nice glowy base and moisture 👍🏼
I love this product! Makes my skin look glowy and lovely. Highly recommend.

I do not love using this on its own, it has a bit of an odd smell to it, its mild but I am particularly sensitive to any smells and it's a little almost musty. On its own it doesn't absorb in well and leaves my skin feeling a little tacky. There is mica in this (a nature glitter of sorts) so it does leave a sparkly sheen. Using just a few pumps with another product bears much better results.
This is a fantastic glowy glass skin makeup prep. It looks so good & feels amazing.

I've been using this serum for few weeks now, and really like how it makes my skin look and feel. It gives my skin a natural glow without looking greasy, which is hard to find. My skin feels soft and hydrated , it's lightweight and doesn't leave any residue. Overall its a great serum if you want hydration, smoothness, and healthy glow all in one.

I love using this product under my makeup. My skin looks so glowy and beautiful and it helps keep my makeup from creasing throughout the day. I get so many compliments on how bright my skin is when using Amino Rain! Love it and would recommend!

This serum is an excellent serum to bring the Bora Barrier cream to the next level of hydration. Plus it has a little glimmer in it so you glow. Perfect for those of us who have lost a bit of glow as we age
Literally idk how but it like works as a treatment for redness like rosacea for me & helped my barrier be stronger! genuinely love the glow, not shimmery, forever re buy!

avis.titre: Love the texture for 66 y/o sentive skin
avis.texte: Mix it with Propini in the morning, and mix it with Marula oil. Love the texture for my 66 y/or sensitive skin.
The added luminescent product seems to be an issue. It's causing clogged pores and itching. Much like glitter or shimmer products

When I first got this I was really skeptical because it has what looks like glitter in the serum and I though forshure this is going to break me out so I gave it time before I left a review and my skin has never looked better.
Great product! Love the packaging bc product doesn't evaporate or air cant get in.. works great! My skin is clear, bright, and glowing.

avis.titre: I will continue to reorder my drunk elephant products as lon
avis.texte: I love being able to modify my daily routine based on what I think my skin needs every day. I know my products mix well together and produce the results I want

avis.titre: The ingredients are stellar for good skin care!
avis.texte: I use several drunk elephant products over five years or so now after changing from another brand since my skin is older in my late 60s, but I have good skin, but it's dry, very dry now. I know what to look for in the ingredient deck on a package. Online and I know that the ingredients in this are exceptional for anti-aging! I took a chance on this because it was less expensive than something that was almost $200 that did not have the ingredients this has in it I'm very impressed as it has long-term effects as well. I always apply anything with hyaluronic acid a cover of moisturizer. this is a very serum that will sink right into your skin. It will not leave any kind of texture tackiness or anything like that. Seal it in with a moisturizer is very important with any kind of hyaluronic acid product although this has glutamic acid in it that makes it supreme. I'm so impressed. I bought one as a back up when there was a sale during the holiday this year. I will not be going back to the near $200 bottle. It's ridiculous! My skin feels wonderful with this and it actually leaves it very smooth with a glass like texture. It's hard to explain because of it not being sticky and heavy, I really like that because I use a heavy moisturizer by drunk elephant, actually two of them and they two are absolutely chalk full of wonderful skincare ingredients that protect our skin barrier thank you drunk elephant for your wonderful products that have kept my skin looking young… young younger than

It should be called 'if you're over 60, you need this stuff!' My skin gets more dry as I age, nothing worked. Finally received this as a sample with an Ulta order. I was hooked and will not be without it. Super hydrating, but absolutely no grease, shine or that oily look. I have 4 jars in my cabinet as I took advantage of the holiday sales. Also very subtle scent that doesn't last at all. If you don't want an itchy, flaky face anymore, you have to try this! Also, zero breakouts! Thank you Tiffany!
I mix with the vitamin c and both together work really well. My face feels soft and improved even look

avis.titre: Amazing product use daily and the results are amazing
avis.texte: Excellent product made my skim feel soft and zero irritation.
I never write reviews but this product impressed me so much. It's so subtly shimmery but not in a glitter or makeup sort of way. It gives such a natural, glowy, beautiful finish to my aging skin.
Love the scent, packaging & name! Works beautifully for makeup prep

avis.titre: I love the way this product looks but the SMELL is repulsive
avis.texte: I love the way my skin looks but I just can't with the smell...I have 2 bottles and each smells disgusting
Hydrating, moisturising and amazing! The glass effect this leaves on the skin is amazing. Very moisturising and great for sensitive skin.
It's a little sticky, and the "luminescence" is just sparkles.

I didn't care much for this product. Yes, it adds a bit of hydration and glow to the skin, but I feel that there are much more effective and cost-efficient serums on the market that achieve these same results and better. Much of the 'glow' this product brings is by way of tiny flecks of glitter throughout the serum, which I don't prefer, personally. If you ARE intent on buying and using this product, I would do so only during the day. I don't trust the glitters in this serum not to interfere somehow with my nighttime skincare routine. It would be nice as a glowy primer, so I am not completely against it. All in all, I feel that this is somewhat lacking in substance and hiked up to a price not reflective of its quality.
Absolutely love! Lightweight and beautiful shimmer on the skin and under makeup! So happy with this product! So recommend!
Well, I like it. I really like it! No oily feeling, just soaks right into your skin leaving it smooth as "glass."

This was my first product from drunk elephant and i'm surprised. It is super gentle on my sensitive/eczema skin and has become a morning skincare staple for me. It is moisturizing and provides my skin a boost. Complimentary from drunkelephant

avis.titre: I would only use this product i've tried so many and so many
avis.texte: I love this serum it's amazing I never had my skin feel and look so nice and i'm 66 years old and don't look it well because I keep up with the new stuff and don't act my age.... it's worth the money

Gifted by Drunk Elephant. This serum is interesting. It is somewhere between skincare and makeup, as it has a pearlescent shimmer that's meant to make skin look glowy. It skews kind of purple, which might not be universally flattering. The dry down is slightly sticky, but it does make my skin feel softer and plumper. It definitely needs to be paired with a rich moisturizer to provide enough hydration for my dry skin.

Weightless, milky hydration with polyglutamic acid, cross‑linked HA & super‑hydrating complex. Instantly luminous, smooths texture, boosts glow "glass skin" magic, but on the pricier side. Gifted by Drunk Elephant

I love this serum! It is so gorgeous on the skin. It has a lightweight texture but leaves me so glowy! My skin looked like it had a drink of water in the morning. This is staying in my routine, I especially love this for day my skin needs a pick me up. Complimentary from drunkelephant

This serum has been a great addition to my skincare routine! My skin looks and feels refreshed after i use it and others notice a difference too! I am obsessed and will buy again in the future! Gifted by drunk elephant

I had a really good experience with this serum. It feels lightweight, hydrates deeply, and left my skin looking smoother and more refreshed. I like the results I've seen so far and will definitely keep it in my routine.

Gifted by drunkelephant I'm a sucker for any product that claims it is hydrating and gives a radiant glow when applying, and this product did not disappoint. When reading the word "acid" I always feel alarmed since I have sensitive skin, but this serum did not seem to irritate or affect my skin in any negative way. It gives me the hydration it claims to give, leaves me with a juvenile and glowing look on my skin that will last all day and not make me look shiny/oily, and pairs very well with my sunscreen and the rest of my makeup as well. It's lightweight, silky, and soft to the touch.

Gifted by drunkelephant A lightweight, silky hydration serum that gives skin a radiant "glass skin" glow. Key Benefits: Boosts hydration instantly (+115%) and lasts up to 24 hours Plumps and improves skin elasticity Supports the skin barrier and repairs dryness Leaves skin smooth, luminous, and makeup-ready Star Ingredients: Polyglutamic Acid (1%) – locks in moisture Hyaluronic Acid Complex – deep, long-lasting hydration Amino Acids + Peptides – strengthen and firm Marula Oil – nourishes and soothes Best For: Normal to dry or combination skin, dullness, dehydration, or anyone wanting a radiant, bouncy finish. Texture/Finish: Milky, weightless, quickly absorbed, with a glowing, "glass-like" finish.

This may be my favorite skincare of the summer! The texture is those lightweight and leaves my skin feeling so hydrated without feeling heavy or greasy. The subtle luminescent effect adds the perfect touch to a no makeup makeup look. Gifted by drunkelephant

I've been using the new Drunk Elephant Amino Rain Glasswater Serum, and it really delivers that fresh, dewy "glass skin" look. The texture is super lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin plump and hydrated without feeling sticky. I love the instant glow it gives, and after a couple weeks my skin looks smoother, firmer, and more radiant. It layers perfectly under makeup and feels gentle enough for everyday use. Complimentary from drunkelephant

This is honestly one of the prettiest serums I have seen in a bit. It looks equally pretty on the skin. It has this faint pearlescent look but just leaves your skin looking glowy. It's glowy but not at all greasy. It's a very pretty skincare that you can wear alone for beautiful glowing skin. Gifted by drunk elephant.

I LOVE this serum. It goes perfectly under my moisturizer, and it leaves my skin bright, smooth, happy, and refreshed. I've been using it for a few weeks, and I am truly obsessed. Would buy again! It's perfect!!

This serum feels so refreshing on my skin. It gives an instant glow, keeps my face looking smooth, and makes my skin feel firmer with every use. It also looks so good under makeup! If you love looking glowy I highly recommend. Gifted by drunk elephant

I've been testing out the new Amino Rain Serum, which I received complimentary from Drunk Elephant, and I'm genuinely impressed with how it performs on my skin. From the very first application, it felt lightweight, refreshing, and almost like giving my skin a big glass of water. The texture is silky and fast-absorbing – not sticky or heavy at all. Once applied, it leaves my skin looking smooth, plump and radiant with that subtle "glass skin" finish I love. My complexion feels instantly hydrated and the glow lasts throughout the day without feeling greasy. What I enjoy most is that it layers beautifully under moisturizer and makeup, keeping my skin balanced and comfortable. It's definitely a serum I reach for when I want my skin to feel fresh, dewy and healthy.

I've been using the Drunk Elephant Amino Rain Glasswater Serum and it feels so good on my skin. The texture is light and silky, almost like water, and it sinks in right away without leaving any tackiness. My skin instantly feels hydrated and soft, and there's a nice dewy glow that makes it look fresh. After using it regularly, my skin feels smoother and looks more plump, especially in the mornings. I like that it works well under my daytime routine and also layers easily with my night creams. It just gives my skin that extra boost of hydration I was looking for. Gifted by drunkelephant

I love how lightweight and refreshing this serum feels on my skin! It absorbs quickly, leaving my face instantly hydrated, plump, and radiant without any sticky residue. The texture is silky and smooth, and my skin looks more luminous and firm after just a few uses. A new staple in my routine! I was gifted by Drunk elephant

Complimentary from drunkelephant love how hydrating this product feels on my skin. I also love the packaging of this product! I highly recommend this to my dry skin girlies plus i have sensitive skin so its perfect

I love this serum it make my skin so soft, smooth, and glowy. My skin looks like glass! It is hydrating and and make my skin look more even. I would highly recommend trying this! gifted by drunk elephant

I absolutely love this serum!! It gives you the most beautiful glass skin as soon as it's applied! I have incredibly dry skin and my skin loves this. I love using this at night because I wake up glowy and hydrated! Also loving this for skin prep! Gifted by drunkelephant

The new Drunk Elephant Amino Glasswater serum is an amazing hydrating serum gives significant hydration to the skin. Perfect for my dry skin. The added benefit of improving elasticity, radiance and glass like skin is a plus too. I love the consistency of the serum and it absorbs well. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

I've been using this serum for a while now and i'm really impressed. It has a lightweight watery texture that absobss quickly into my skin. It feels refreshing and cooling once applied. I love that it provides long lasting hydration. Highly recommend. Gifted by drunk elephant
Have more compliments every day on how "refreshed" my skin looks. Incredible! Highly recommend this product

This is my first drunk elephant product and I LOVE IT! This serum goes on so smooth, hydrates skin, and is super light! It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin at all. Also love the packaging. Definitely recommend! Gifted by drunkelephant

I absolutely love this product! Drunk elephant kills it every time. I know that the products are expensive, but it is absolutely worth it. And surprisingly these products last a long time too this product was gifted by drunk elephant.

The Amino Rain Glasswater Serum feels like a refreshing drink of water for my skin! 💦 The texture is so lightweight and silky, it sinks in instantly and leaves my face super smooth, plump, and glowing. What makes it special is the "glass skin" effect — my complexion looks clearer and more even right after applying, and over time I've noticed more hydration and bounce. It layers beautifully under moisturizer or makeup, making it a perfect everyday serum. ✨ "gifted by drunkelephant"

This serum is amazing for my sensitive and oily skin. The fragrance is so refreshing and I just love how it feels! I recommend this to all my sensitive skin skincare lovers out there! Gifted by drunk elephant

I tried the Amino Rain Glasswater Serum gifted by Drunk elephant and I can say it gives my skin exactly what it needs. Its texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and I love its presentation: it contains subtle shimmers that leave the skin with a radiant finish. After several days of use, I've noticed my skin feels more hydrated, smooth, luminous, and with better texture. It also feels firmer and healthier. Another detail I truly appreciate is its practical dispenser, which releases just the right amount of product, and its secure closing system that prevents spills, especially when I carry it in my bag. I absolutely love it.

This glasswater serum is game changer! I can immediately tell the difference in my skin in terms of moisture and hydration, it's lightweight and has a non-greasy feel. It leaves my skin glowy and brightened! I love using this in the morning to wake up my skin, as someone who's acne prone this doesn't cause any skin irritation or increased acne so it's great for sensitive skin! Complimentary from drunkelephant.

This serum has a cool name and works as it called. My skin is so hydrated instantly when I apply it. It is a treat to use in the hot summer day as it feels light on skin, My face also doesn't turn too shiny and greasy after application. complimentary from drunkelephant

This serum feels so refreshing and lightweight on my skin. It absorbs quickly and leaves my face looking dewy and hydrated all day without feeling greasy. My skin feels plump and smooth and it has become a perfect step in my daily routine. Complimentary from drunkelephant

This serum has been a great addition to my skincare routine. The serum adds hydration without feeling heavy and adds a luminescent effect without making my skin look greasy. The product doesn't have a smell which is nice as well. Gifted by drunkelephant

this was gifted by drunk elephant in exchange of my honest opinion , this is okay product, it's hydrating and it leaves your skin feeling nice, and the packaging is also really nice but definitely not worth the price.

I really wanted to love this serum I was Gifted by drunkelephant. I really love how hydrating this serum is and it really helped plump my skin with hydration. Unfortunately I didn't like all the shimmer or pearlizing sparkles. This had my face looking all kinds of shiny in all the wrong ways. This shimmer sat in my large pores and almost highlighted them. I also didn't like what it did for my fine lines and wrinkles. I would really love this serum without all the shimmer.

I've been wearing this Amino Rain Glasswater serum for my morning routine and love it! It looks so beautiful on the skin. It feels lightweight, smoothing and gives my skin a gorgeous luminous shine. Also great for under makeup. Gifted by drunk elephant

I absolutely Love this serum gifted by drunk elephant. It gives me such a beautiful glowing glass skin after every use. This has become my number one skin prep product before makeup. I highly recommend this.

This is a neat serum as it has ingredients that create a glow naturally and a bit of shimmer that instantly gives you a glow. I like the combination of long term and instant results. I have liked this as a makeup base since it makes my skin look glowy. So far the serum aspect of it feels like a simple hydrating serum. Not so intense your skin will get irritated. Just a good dose of hydration. I like the style of packaging where the cap twists up to open. On this particular serum the product does drip down the front after you use it. I can see it getting messy if you don't wipe it clean each time. For a high end product that can be a turn off for some people. Gifted by drunkelephant

I love Drunk Elephant and was so excited to try this out. This has been great, not too harsh on my skin. I feel like my skin is tighter, smoother and I definitely see less lines! *Complimentary from drunkelephant

This leaves my skin plump and hydrated without any stickiness. The texture feels silky, absorbing quickly while giving a subtle dewy glow. I noticed my skin looking smoother and more balanced after just a few uses. It's a great everyday serum if you want hydration and radiance without heaviness. complimentary from drunkelephant

I've been enjoying this serum so much. It's very hydrating and soothing. It's perfect for my dry skin. The texture is a little bit creamy but it feels very lightweight and a little goes a long way. I love how glowy my skin looks when I use it. Gifted by drunkelephant but opinions are my own.

The Peptide Glow Barrier Cream feels soft and smooth on my skin. It keeps my face hydrated without being heavy. After a week, my skin looks fresh, strong, and full of glow. I'm obsessed and can't wait to get more results! Gifted by DrunkElephant.

I was able to try Drunk Elephant Amnio rain glass water serum and I'm highly impressed. The formula is stunning and feels good on my skin. My skin is feeling hydrated and has an instant glow. It's lightweight and absorbs fast into my skin without any issues. The formula isn't sticky and awakes my skin especially in the morning. I would highly recommend it. Complimentary from drunkelephant

I really enjoyed using this serum. It applied beautifully, leaving my skin glowy and pretty, ai don't know the long term benefits yet, but it's a good product if you would like a quick change. I paired with my normal moisturizer that I use every day and I liked the result. Gifted by drunkelephant

It feels so lightweight yet delivers deep hydration that leaves my skin looking fresh, plump, and luminous all day. I love how quickly it absorbs without any stickiness, making it perfect under makeup or on its own. My complexion has been looking smoother and more radiant since I started using it, and it gives me that healthy glow I've been searching for. Definitely a new favorite in my routine! Gifted by Drunk Elephant

I really like this serum. It has some great ingredients and has no fragrance in it. I apply a good amount on my skin and message it into my skin. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated, smooth and plump. I highly recommend this serum. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

This is a perfect addition to any of my routines. With it being focused on hydration mainly, it can also be mixed with another serum for different results. The color to this had me concerned as i have large pores and scars, but it was very muted and didn't cause any "disco ball" effect. I love using this and will continue to keep it in rotation. Complimentary from brand. For those reading reviews - please patch test new products! Do not use them all over for nights in a row and then call the product bad.

The serum is quite nice! I like the way that the bottle is formed to get the product out with the twist cap. The serum itself is nice however I didn't notice a huge difference after using it for over a week. Seems a little expensive for how much product is in the container. Complimentary from drunkelephant

I have been using the serum for the past week and I love how it applies onto the skin. I use it every morning during my skin care prep and it makes my skin look glowy. It is lightweight and it's great to use alone or under make up. Gifted by Drunk Elephant

The serum has a lightweight texture but it's thicker than a regular serum . It has a lightly shimmery texture but not too much and won't make you look like you just apply shimmer . I feel a little sticky after applying . There's a light to unnoticeable scent to it . I've heard so many good compliments about Drunk elephant so I'll definitely keep using it for more resort .Gifted by drunkelephant .

This serum is bomb! My skin looks so much radiant and youthful! It absorbs well and gives me that glow kind of finish! If you want glass skin, this is a must-try! So worth it! 💕💕💕 Gifted by drunkelephant

This glass water serum gifted to me by Drunk Elephant does a great job of making my skin look super healthy. I like that it gives it a nice natural glow and shimmer. I like to use it by itself on no makeup days.

Complimentary from drunkelephant! I absolutely will always need a good boost of hydration and this does not disappoint! Makes my skin feel plump and hydrated right away! A small amount goes a long way!I'm

I love the texture of this serum it's smooth and hydrating. It's lightweight and fast absorbing on my skin and décolleté. I love the color of the formula it's stunning and works really well on my combo skin type. I love it's buildable on the skin if you adore more irredecent finish on the skin.

Gifted by drunkelephant. This serum is SO nice! I have dry skin, so I immediately gravitate to something hydrating and my skin loved this right off the bat. The texture is light but very hydrating, and it absorbs extremely well. It gives my skin a beautiful glow, and also a plumpness that lasts all day. I'm so impressed with this serum, and I can't stop using it. I would absolutely recommend picking this up if you want something hydrating that will really nourish your skin.

I received this complimentary from drunkelephant for my honest review. I found this product to go on light. I followed the instructions that included one pump for application. However, I found that i was experiencing redness after application. There appears to be glitter or something in the formula. Product did not work for my combination skin. I would not recommend this product.

Got the chance to receive this Complimentary from drunkelephant. Provides instant hydration and leaves a glowy finish. Gentle on the skin as well and one pump goes a long way so the product will last quite a while

I recently received Gifted by drunkelephant and it's honestly they best thing ever! At first I thought it was just another serum, but it isn't. This serum is gorgeous, and gives you such a nice glow! I started using this as a primer/base before my makeup application and it's the best thing ever. It gives my dry skin such a nice glow and look dewy throughout the day. Overall, I love this for my dry skin and it's been looking amazing.

avis.titre: If you want the glass skin effect, grab this serum!
avis.texte: This serum is absolutely stunning! From the very first use, my skin felt instantly quenched and soothed, and the lightweight texture sinks in effortlessly, leaving behind the most beautiful, subtle opalescent glow that gives a glass skin effect without any heaviness. The hydration truly lasts all day thanks to the hyaluronic acid complex. I also love that it works well under makeup, giving me a naturally luminous base. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

I'm loving this serum! My skin looks and feels so glowy and this has a bit of shimmer that looks so beautiful on the skin. I like wearing this as a serum at night and my skin looks so good in the morning! Gifted by drunk elephant

This serum is so beautiful. The drunk elegant packaging is always superior. From the mechanism to the actual dispensing. This serum makes my skin feel so luxe and smooth. Plumper somehow, even! I love this. Gifted by drunk elephant.

Really impressed with this one. It absorbs fast and makes my skin feel firmer and more even. No irritation and I love how clean the formula feels. It's a bit pricey but worth it for how much glow and bounce it brings to my routine. Gifted by drunkelephant

I've been trying out the NEW! Amino Rain Glasswater Serum and I'm so impressed! 💧 The formula is ultra-lightweight, sinks in instantly, and gives my skin that fresh, hydrated, glass-like glow without feeling greasy. 🌿 The amino acids help strengthen and support the skin barrier, while leaving my complexion smooth, soft, and radiant. It layers beautifully with the rest of my skincare and feels like the perfect everyday serum for hydration + glow. If you're into products that deliver both treatment and luminosity, this one is such a win! ✨

avis.titre: Great quality and works really well!
avis.texte: Drunk Elephant does it again... glow, firm, and hydrate all in one! Totally worth it! I'm a huge fan of DE's products and this is no different. If you are looking for glow, firming, and plumping with a formulation that covers those bases with multiple ingredients for each, then look no further. The packaging is sleek and practical (no caps to worry about yay!), and the serum itself glides on effortlessly, dries quickly, and leaves no tacky residue. The serum has a slight tint, but it does not pigment the skin. Several ingredients make the application feel luxurious. It's perfect for your morning routine. Gifted by drunkelephant.

Complimentary from The Drunk Elephant Amino Rain Glasswater Serum makes my skin feel instantly plump and hydrated. It gives me a dewy, fresh glow without feeling heavy or sticky. I love how smooth and soft my skin looks after each use.

This serum has been a win for me for daytime use under my makeup. The opalescent color of the serum brightens my face instantly and gives it the most natural glow without looking greasy. I have to be really careful with what I put on my face because my combination skin tends to get oily and this serum does not make it oily at all. I like the fermented poly amino acid ingredient because my skin has done well with fermented ingredients in the past. It is too soon to see firming effects but I will look forward to seeing if there is a difference in the future. You can of course use this at night but I love the benefits of using it during the day. Gifted by drunkelephant.

[Complimentary from Drunk Elephant] This is the best glass skin serum I've tried! I put this on overnight and my skin looks soooo glowy in the morning. It's safe for sensitive skin too! I would recommend.

Complimentary from drunkelephant. This serum is AMAZING!!! I thought I was able to achieve the dewiest of dewy skin before, but let me tell you, this takes it up a notch! It's super lightweight and hydrating with the barest hint of pearlescent tint that you can see instantly after applying—your skin literally looks like glass, it's insane! I've tried it in a bunch of different orders in my skincare routine (e.g. first step, somewhere in the middle, last step) and all the ways are amazing. I even tried it all by itself after washing my face and even though it's really thin and light it was moisturizing enough for my super dry skin. I'm looking forward to cocktailing it with a body lotion and maybe foundation to see how that goes.

Love this serum! It's so lightweight and d hydrating on my skin. My skin glows after using it! I have not experienced any issues or irritation while using g this product. I will definitely will be buying it again once I finish this bottle! Gifted by drunkelephant

I absolutely love Drunk Elephant, this has to be my new favorite product! It makes my skin super moisturized and gives it the perfect glass skin finish. My skin is really hydrated and this product is so light and not greasy or sticky! Definitely a new love! Gifted by Drunk Elephant for an honest opinion!

Such a pretty serum that makes my skin looks so dewy and hydrated! It has a pearlescent finish to it that's a little cool toned, it's like a reflective purple hue, which I really love! It feels super lightweight as well! Gifted by Drunk Elephant

The best thing about the serum is how many ways you can use it! It's great to have in your skincare lineup because it can enhance whatever look you're going for. The product has a luminizing effect, so it's perfect to wear under your makeup for a beautiful glow (it's also ultra-hydrating so it acts as a great primer under makeup as well!) I also mixed this with my eye cream during the day to give my under eye area a brighter, more awake look. (Same with body lotion—I added a few drops of this serum to my body lotion to highlight my chest, shoulders and collarbones!) I also like wearing this on a no-makeup day because it gives me a nice little glow that makes me feel more confident in my bare skin. The texture is lightweight and it absorbs easily. Not sticky! As I said, it is very hydrating and makes my skin look more supple as a result—this is an essential for my glass skin routine! Gifted by drunkelephant

This glass water serum feels so milky and lux on my skin! It does leave a slight tackiness after applying, but this goes away. It makes my skin feel hydrated without the weight of a heavy moisturizer, and gives a gorgeous glowy radiance! Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

This is a super dewy serum that gives skin a gorgeous glow. It's kind of golden and kind of pink, but it really just looks like a super delicate, finely milled shimmer on the skin. It is pretty shimmery, so this isn't a serum that you can really layer on or else you might look super shiny. I think this works great under makeup. It dries down pretty tacky, so it kind of acts like a primer. Overall I'm enjoying it! Gifted by Drunk Elephant

I can't say that this product transformed my skin because I haven't used it that long, but I can't say that it does feel hydrating on my skin. I can say for me personally I really do like the shimmer in it as long as it's not hurting or hindering my skin. I'm here for it. Gifted by drunkelephant

avis.titre: Why have glitter in a serum?!
avis.texte: I received a sample as a gift with purchase. I was interested in it based on the description and excited to try it. Nowhere that I saw did it mention glitter! Why would I want fine glitter in something that supposed to be skincare? I had to wash my face again after I noticed so it wouldn't spread to my pillow! Would do zero stars as a skincare product. C'mon Drink Elephant and just be honest and market it as some sort of shimmer oil for the body.

avis.texte: I received a sample as a gift with purchase. I was interested in it based on the description and excited to try it. Nowhere that I saw did it mention glitter! Why would I want fine glitter in something that supposed to be skincare? I had to wash my face again after I noticed so it wouldn't spread to my pillow! Would do zero stars as a skincare product. C'mon Drink Elephant and just be honest and market it as some sort of shimmer oil for the body.

My skin has been extra dry this summer, and I've been trying different serums and moisturizers with little success-until I tried this Drunk Elephant serum. My skin was immediately radiant and glowy, and felt hydrated for the first time in months. And the hydration lasts all day! I'm so impressed and thankful that my skin feels healthy and soft again. This was gifted by Drunk Elephant.

I love this lightweight, hydrating serum. It delivers instant radiance and hydration. It also helps firm and soothe the skin while giving it a subtle glow. The texture is smooth and fast-absorbing. This was gifted by Drunk Elephant.

avis.titre: Great for you glass skin routine
avis.texte: Results delivered asap after one use.. my skin looked so dewy and "glass like" . Definitely recommend for those no makeup days and to incorporate in your daily glass skin routine. Definitely worth it! Gifted by Drunk Elephant

I love the opalescent shimmer it has to it and the way it makes my skin glow 🤩 it's hydrating yet lightweight and doesn't break out my blemish prone skin which is always a plus. A wonderful addition to my skincare routine! Gifted by drunkelephant.

Amino Rain Glasswater Serum is lightweight and deeply hydrating. It leaves my skin looking plump and radiant. It absorbs quickly without feeling sticky and gives an instant glassy glow while keeping skin soft. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

Nice serum, really hydrating which works well for my combination skin. Doesn't make my skin oily and soothes my skin, while new products usually irritate when I first try, this one doesn't. Gifted by drunk elephant

The Amino Rain Glasswater Serum gifted by Drunk Elephant feels so refreshing on my skin. It sinks in quickly, leaves my face super hydrated, and gives me a healthy, glassy glow without feeling heavy. Perfect for everyday use.

I really like my new serum. The packaging is very convenient, and I can take it with me. I apply it twice a day, in the morning and evening, and also during the day before makeup. It provides enough hydration for my skin and gives it a nice glow. I also like the ingredients, and there are no harmful ones. Gifted by drunkelephant

I've been using thi serum and I love how fresh and glowy it makes my skin look! It feels super lightweight, sinks in right away, and gives me that healthy, glassy finish without being greasy. Perfect under makeup or on its own. Gifted by drunk elephant

I'm loving this lightweight serum gifted by Drunk Elephant. It absorbs into skin quickly and makes skin more hydrated and smooth. Despite lightweight texture, this serum really moisturizes. I love the multiple clean ingredients with hydrating properties. My skin looks healthier and moisturized after only a few uses.

Complimentary from drunkelephant. This is one of the best serums that I have ever tried. It absorbs into the skin so nicely without leaving a residue, but also is make sure that your skin looks so shiny and healthy and glowing from within from how amazing it is.

Drunk Elephant Amino Rain Glasswater Serum was kindly gifted to me by the brand. This is a lightweight, fast-absorbing serum that delivers intense hydration and a dewy, glass-like glow. With polyglutamic acid, hyaluronic acids, and peptides, it deeply moisturizes without feeling sticky or heavy.

I got this product complimentary from drunk elephant for my honest review. I love how instantly glowy my skin looked after just one use! The hydration is unbelievable! I'll definitely be replacing a few products with this ONE because it's that good and can do so much!

Complimentary from drunkelephant. I have tried this Amino Rain Glasswarer Serum from Drunk Elephant for a couple of days now and I have enjoyed it so far. It is very lightweight. It doesn't take long to dry, which is what I like about this. It gave my skin more glowingly look.

This glass water serum is great. When I put it on my skin feels so bouncy and looks so radiant and it last all day. I love the way the serum itself looks it's so pretty so it makes me want to use it more. It have no smell and it's great for sensitive skin like mine. The results speak for itself. Gifted by drunkelephant

The Amino Rain Glasswater Serum feels like a burst of hydration the moment it touches the skin. The texture is silky and lightweight, and it sinks in without leaving any stickiness. What makes it stand out is the instant glow it gives — that soft, luminous, almost opalescent finish that makes the skin look fresh and awake right away. With continued use, the serum not only enhances radiance but also makes the skin feel smoother, firmer, and more even in tone. It calms and soothes, leaving the complexion balanced and comfortable, while delivering that coveted "glass skin" effect. A beautiful blend of hydration and luminosity in one bottle. Complimentary from drunkelephant

I really like how hydrating and smoothing this serum is. I have dry skin and this gives me an instant glow without feeling heavy, and it layers nicely under moisturizer or makeup. If you like a dewy, luminous look, this is a great option, though it might feel a bit too glowy if you prefer a matte finish. Gifted by drunk elephant.

avis.titre: Gave me whiteheads all over my face
avis.texte: Received as a sample and used it as night time for two nights in a row. I used only this serum both nights and broke out over night, each time. I havent broken out in a while so it was definitely this product. I do like some other Drunk Elephant products but this one is a pass for me.

Gifted by Drunk Elephant. I have combination, acne-prone skin, so I have to be very careful with what I use on my skin. Drink Elephant has always been a big winner for me, and the Amino Rain Glasswater Serum does not disappoint. There is a glittery shimmer in the formula that I really like. It leaves my skin looking younger and with a healthy glow. I've been using the serum for about two weeks, and my skin feels smoother and looks less uneven. Loving the texture of this product. Lightweight and never leaving my skin oily or dry.
